cc:Work.dc:title: runtime-cost
cc:Work.dc:description: Historical local diagnostics. Left: repeated observations grouped by configuration, retaining ranges for means and p99; conditions change at the dashed line. Right: the combined-submission bar uses the archived observation 491.370 + 140.345, while labels retain the full repeated-run ranges without pooling statistics. The reduction from 303–307 to 138–140 preceded combining submissions. Local results do not replace cross-host validation.
